title: 第9章 青衣事了 等待大鱼第10章 互相算计 谁更精彩
content_zh:
那就先解决这几个不知天高地厚的家伙。
擒贼先擒王，射人先射马。
郑风几个漂浮游走，几位骑手纷纷策马避让。
青衣领队大怒，这时候还敢临阵撤退，那不是把他单独留给了郑风单挑。
能单挑吗？“一群蠢货！”
“他们不蠢，蠢的是你！”
郑风一道风雷剑施展开来，风之速，雷之厉，雷霆炸响，剑气雷霆直奔青衣领队，体内“五神阵”在“炼化诛神阵”加持后，郑风的身体就是神兵利器，亦是移动阵盘，这时候的风雷剑，比起天元大陆施展那是上了一个大大的台阶。
这次施展郑风不再担心这方天地承受不起他一个小小武君的全力施为，肆无忌惮的倾泻神力。
有了"炼化诛神阵”融合后的身体，不再是原来“五神阵”五神珠的金木水火土五神力，风神力和雷霆力不甘寂寞，在战斗时猛的一塌糊涂。
青衣领队被炸得头脑昏厥，四肢发麻，从马上摔了下来，因为他的马已经被炸的全身焦黑，空气中混杂着有人肉也有马肉焦糊味，还混杂有淡淡的肉香。
或许就是评价厨艺常说的外焦里嫩，只是外面就焦得过了些，都黑糊了。
“厨艺不咋样啊！”郑风摇了摇头，似乎有些不满意，其实心里乐开了花。
原以为自己进入神界对上本地的武君，会很难缠，要费一些手脚，现在才知道自己有多优秀有多强。郑风觉得心里自得一下，为自己增强一点点自信是可以的。
他这一摇头，几位骑手纷纷下马，他们的马早就不能动了，跪了！
青衣领队现在是死得难看，被雷霆霹得黑糊，震伤了五脏六腑，被风雷剑气千刀万剐，一块块肉都是下面黑糊，上面鲜活，就是一道按照人体造型摆盘的菜肴，好不好吃不知道，摆盘造型将就过得去，色彩搭配也是勉勉强强。
狮子搏兔亦用全力，为的就是一击毙命。
青衣领队是武君，是郑风进入神界来遇到的第一个交手的武君。被救下的少年也是武君，只是神魂被禁锢，没有真正交流。郑风没想到，这一次用力有点猛了，很是遗憾。
原本打算活捉青衣领队，研究一下对方体内的神力，没想到做成了一盘菜，还是有些倒胃口的菜。损失巨大，郑风非常痛心，看起来脸色也十分痛苦。
“高人，你就高抬贵手，把我们放了吧，我们都是一时糊涂，才听从队长命令追捕阁下。”一骑手反应快率先跪地求饶。
“如今队长已死，队员也死了四人，我们几个小虾米，你就当个屁放了吧！“几位骑手声泪俱下，磕头如捣蒜。

几个叫嚣得欢畅的，前三次交锋就死了。出手拧下队友脑袋的家伙，都被郑风解决青衣队长时一并解决了。
郑风感觉面前几人修为不咋地，估计也没有多少神力可提供自己研究，主要是他们诚心悔过的态度得到郑风的认可。这几个说不上好，也不是十恶不赦，郑风打算饶了他们。
“有两个问题需要你们如实回答，你们队长是如何和其他巡逻队联系的？“
”我们巡逻队首领都有一个位置跟踪器，在危及的时候只要按下追踪器，附近数百里的巡逻队都能感应到。“一骑手急忙回复。
”那就是说追踪器如果没有按下，周围的人就感应不到？“郑风觉得这个信息很重要。
”是这样的，如果平日里都能感应到，大家就没有自由了。还有追踪器开启定位耗费也很大，所以一个队伍里只有队长才配备了这个装置。“郑风听得解释顿时明白了。
content_en:
Then let’s deal with these guys who don’t know the heights of the world first.
To capture a thief, capture the king first; to shoot a man, shoot a horse first.
Zheng Feng floated away, and several riders rode their horses to get out of the way.
The leader in Tsing Yi was furious. If he dared to retreat at this time, he would not be left alone with Zheng Feng.
Can you challenge me one on one? "A bunch of idiots!"
"They are not stupid, you are the stupid one!"
Zheng Feng deployed a wind and thunder sword, with the speed of the wind, the force of the thunder, and the thunder. The sword energy and thunder went straight to the leader in green. After the "Five God Formation" in his body was blessed by the "Refining and Killing God Formation", Zheng Feng's body was a divine weapon and a mobile array. The wind and thunder sword at this time was a big step up from the one used by Tianyuan Continent.
This time when Zheng Feng used it, he no longer worried that the world would not be able to bear the full strength of a little martial lord like him, and he poured out his divine power unscrupulously.
With the body after the fusion of the "Refining and Killing God Formation", the five divine powers of gold, wood, water, fire, earth, and the five divine beads of the original "Five God Formation" are no longer the five divine powers of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth.
The leader in Tsing Yi was knocked unconscious by the explosion, his limbs were numb, and he fell off his horse, because his horse had been completely burnt black by the explosion, and the air was mixed with the smell of burnt human flesh and horse meat, as well as a faint scent of meat.
Perhaps it's because the outside is burnt and the inside is tender as is often said when evaluating cooking skills, but the outside is too burnt and turned black.
"My cooking skills are not that good!" Zheng Feng shook his head, seeming a little dissatisfied, but actually he was very happy.
I thought that when I entered the God Realm and faced off against the local Martial Lords, it would be difficult and that I would have to spend some effort. But now I know how good and strong I am. Zheng Feng felt proud that it was okay to build up a little bit of self-confidence for himself.
As soon as he shook his head, several riders dismounted one after another. Their horses could no longer move and knelt down!
The leader in Tsing Yi is now in an ugly state of death. He was blackened by thunderbolts, his internal organs were injured, and he was cut into pieces by the wind and thunder sword energy. The pieces of meat were black on the bottom and fresh on the top. It was just a dish arranged in the shape of a human body. I don't know if it tasted good or not. The presentation was just passable, and the color matching was barely adequate.
A lion fights a rabbit with all his strength, just to kill him with one blow.
The leader of the team in Tsing Yi is Wu Jun. He is the first Wu Jun Zheng Feng encounters when he enters the God Realm. The young man who was rescued was also Lord Wu, but his soul was imprisoned and there was no real communication. Zheng Feng didn't expect that he used too much force this time, which was a pity.
The original plan was to capture the leader in Tsing Yi alive and study the divine power in his body, but he didn't expect that the dish turned out to be somewhat unappetizing. The loss was huge, Zheng Feng was very sad, and his face looked very painful.
"Master, please be noble and let us go. We were all confused for a moment, so we followed the captain's order to hunt you down." A rider reacted quickly and was the first to kneel down and beg for mercy.
"Now that the captain is dead, and four members of the team have also died, we little shrimps, just think of it as nothing!" Several riders burst into tears and kowtowed like garlic.
A few who shouted happily died in the first three confrontations. The guys who tried to twist off the heads of his teammates were all killed by Zheng Feng when he killed the Qing Yi captain.
Zheng Feng felt that the cultivation of the few people in front of him was not very good, and they probably did not have much divine power to provide him with research. The main reason was that their sincere and repentant attitude was recognized by Zheng Feng. These few were neither good nor heinous. Zheng Feng planned to spare them.
"There are two questions that you need to answer truthfully. How does your captain contact other patrol teams?"
"Our patrol leader has a location tracker. When in danger, as long as he presses the tracker, patrols hundreds of miles away can sense it." A rider replied hurriedly.
"That means that if the tracker is not pressed, people around will not be able to sense it?" Zheng Feng thinks this information is very important.
"It's like this. If you can feel it every day, you won't have any trouble."By. It also costs a lot to activate and locate the tracker, so only the leader of a team is equipped with this device. "Zheng Feng understood immediately after hearing the explanation.
